ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Defense Evasion Via Binary Rename
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a renamed binary often used by attackers or malware leveraging new Sysmon OriginalFileName datapoint.

sequences.query: (process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe" OR process_original_file_name = "CONHOST\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "7z\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "7za\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "WinRAR\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "wevtutil\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net1\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "InstallUtil\.exe") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\conhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\7z\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\7za\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WinRAR\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wevtutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\InstallUtil\\\.exe$")))
